anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved nothing on these two facts: both outputs present exactly two options that render as 1. and 2., separated from the three numbered concerns by the prose line "Pick one:" (plus a blank line), which is enough to break the Markdown list so the options restart at 1; and both checkpoint 2 continuations open with the single sentence "Taking 4 as option 1 - Approve issue 1 - Retry failed imports; decline issue 2" before simulating creation of issue 1 only and stating issue 2 is not created, with no raw option-4 action and no re-ask. The only fragility is that the separator is a single short label in both; if you want the menu contract to be robust against renderers or readers that treat "Pick one:" as part of the preceding list, have the gate emit the concerns as bullets or put a horizontal rule or a full sentence (e.g. "Those are the concerns; choose one of the two subset approvals below:") between the concerns and the options, keeping the two options and the one-sentence resolved-selection echo exactly as they are.
